title: Next-cycle forwarding uses stale writeback
desc: A next-cycle dependency reads the normal writeback port instead of the dedicated forwarding result.
trigger: Execute dependent instructions whose producer result is available only through next-cycle forwarding.

title: Cross-line prediction ignores sequential PC
desc: A cross-line instruction always uses the branch predictor target instead of the sequential next PC.
trigger: Fetch a cross-line instruction when the branch predictor supplies a different target.

title: SUB decoded as ADD
desc: Only the standard 32-bit SUB instruction is mapped to ADD.
trigger: Disable RVC and execute SUB with unequal nonzero operands.

title: SRA decoded as SRL
desc: Only the standard 32-bit SRA instruction is mapped to logical right shift.
trigger: Disable RVC and execute SRA on a value with the sign bit set.

title: SLT decoded as SLTU
desc: Only the standard 32-bit SLT instruction uses unsigned comparison.
trigger: Disable RVC and compare -1 with +1 using SLT.

title: RV64 shifts use a 5-bit shift amount
desc: Non-word RV64 shifts incorrectly ignore src2[5], aliasing shift amounts 32-63 to 0-31.
trigger: On RV64 execute SLL with rs1=1 and rs2=32.

title: LB decoded as LW
desc: LB is decoded as a signed word load instead of a signed byte load.
trigger: Load a byte whose surrounding word contains different upper bytes.

title: AND executed as OR
desc: AND returns the bitwise OR of its operands.
trigger: Execute AND with operands that have disjoint set bits.

title: BEQ condition inverted
desc: BEQ is taken when its operands differ and not taken when they are equal.
trigger: Execute BEQ once with equal operands and once with unequal operands.

title: Divide-by-zero quotient is zero
desc: DIV/DIVU by zero return quotient 0 rather than all ones; REM remains unchanged.
trigger: Execute DIV or DIVU with rs2=0.

title: Quotient sign ignores divisor
desc: Signed quotient sign follows only the dividend sign and ignores the divisor sign.
trigger: Execute DIV with positive dividend and negative divisor, e.g. 7 / -3.

title: Remainder sign follows divisor
desc: For normal signed remainder, the result sign follows the divisor instead of the dividend; divide-by-zero keeps the original dividend sign.
trigger: Execute REM with negative dividend and positive divisor, e.g. -7 % 3.

title: Dividend magnitude uses divisor
desc: The divider derives both operand magnitudes and the dividend sign from the divisor.
trigger: Execute DIV or REM with operands having different magnitudes or signs.

title: Divider runs an extra iteration
desc: The divider waits for count len instead of len-1 before finishing.
trigger: Execute any DIV or REM instruction and observe the incorrect iteration count or result.

title: Divider valid condition inverted
desc: The divider asserts output valid in every state except the finish state.
trigger: Execute DIV or REM and check the output valid handshake.

title: LH/LHU sign/zero extension swapped
desc: LH is zero-extended and LHU is sign-extended.
trigger: Load halfword 0x8001 with LH or LHU.

title: Byte offset 1 selects byte 0
desc: A byte load at address offset 1 incorrectly returns the byte at offset 0.
trigger: Store bytes 0x11,0x22 at base+0/base+1; execute LBU base+1.

title: LB uses bus MSB as sign bit
desc: LB extends using the full returned bus MSB instead of the selected byte sign bit.
trigger: Return a bus word whose selected byte is 0x80 while the bus MSB is 0.

title: Word access uses a halfword mask
desc: A word-sized memory access enables only two bytes instead of four.
trigger: Store a word with nonzero upper halfword and load it back.

title: LB sign-extends the low word
desc: LB sign-extends 32 selected bits rather than the selected byte.
trigger: Load a byte while bits 8-31 of the returned word differ from the byte sign extension.
